verdict.rationale: Sill is a free, local-only app that streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad for touch, keyboard and Pencil control. It has no account, no server and no user dataset, so AI-generated insights from the user's data is a category error for this kind of product. The "candidates" in the support docs refer to keyboard input composition, not AI suggestions, and nothing in the pack shows the product ships such a feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
